objective: Find tied drafter designs with greater teacher-forced token agreement at lower measured latency.

design.timing: 20 warmed pairs, alternating model order; same eight-GPU mesh; loss forward, excluding compilation, load and restriction.
design.selection: Rank calibration candidates by agreement and measured latency; confirm at most three non-dominated variants plus identity. Prefer high agreement, disclose loss changes; no tuning on confirmation batches.

interpretation.scope: Current teacher-forced token prediction, not future update prediction or end-to-end pretraining acceleration.
interpretation.floPs: Leading linear matmul estimate; excludes attention interactions, KDA recurrence and transport.
interpretation.sampling: Batches are separate stream indices; document-level disjointness has not been established.
interpretation.checkpoint_difference: Earlier half/quarter-compute sanity used step256 current weights. This sweep uses step2116 EMA and requires its own full-model reference.
interpretation.gain: Global multiplier on existing routing_renorm_sum; not the per-token reference-set normalization in the cited paper.
interpretation.importance: ReLU-squared weight-only score ||up||^4 ||down||^2, separately per layer/expert; structured heuristic, not activation-calibrated Wanda.
interpretation.quantization: Existing FP8 dispatch sends expert-input activations in block-scaled e4m3; computation, weights and combine remain as in baseline.

budget.additional_budget: User explicitly removed budget gating and instructed continuation.
budget.original_cap_scope: 10 GPU-hours applied to the initial feasibility phase in the assistant-written experiment goal, not a user-stated lifetime ceiling for follow-up experiments.
budget.authorization_correction: User questioned the GPU budget. Inspection found plan.html calls 10 GPU-hours a proposed first-stage cap and experiment-goal.txt limits its scope to initial feasibility. Do not carry it forward as a global approval requirement.

local_validation: analytic selected-channel output, checkpoint roundtrip, 15 full-scale shape/sharding traces

analysis_validation.scope: Reducer regression using preserved size-sanity measurements adapted in memory; not new latency-sweep results

revision_reason: Replicate checkpoint leaves without explicit initializer sharding; no model or metric changes.

retained_options.fp8_dispatch: Retain as a configurable option per user instruction. Small-model timing does not establish performance at larger payload sizes or across nodes. Larger-model speedup remains a hypothesis; evaluate quantization overhead against saved communication.
